originals.ko: 나는 모든 사람에게 너를 도와 달라고 부탁하면 안 돼
originals.why: Welsh is natural North Welsh. Here gofyn i means 'ask someone to do something', so 부탁하다 is used: the 묻다 gloss (ask a question) is ungrammatical with 도와 달라고. i bawb keeps the 'to everyone' sense, which 에게 covers.

originals.ko: 나는 모든 사람에게 내가 무엇을 하고 싶은지 말하면 안 돼
originals.why: The Welsh uses 'wrth bawb' (deud wrth), not 'i bawb', so this phrase does not contain the LEGO it was moved into
